title: Resolution to set property tax rates for fiscal year 2027
summary: This resolution fixes the city's real property tax rates for fiscal year 2027, which runs from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, authorizing a total real property tax levy of about $39.9 billion. It sets rates for four property classes, including 0.20909 for one-, two- and three-family homes and 0.12440 for other residential property. The resolution also directs the Finance Commissioner to apply these rates on the certified assessment rolls and collect the resulting taxes.
